key.name: copy-link-on-new-call
key.summary: Copy the call link when starting a new call

key.name: notify-joins
key.summary: Notify when someone joins your call

key.name: show-avatars
key.summary: Show profile pictures (from Gravatar, as Tuple's own apps do)

key.name: tuple-command
key.summary: The tuple command (a name on PATH or ~/.local/bin, or a full path)

key.name: camera-device
key.summary: Camera (name or /dev path; blank: system default)

key.name: mic-device
key.summary: Microphone (PipeWire source name; blank: system default)

key.name: camera-follows-share
key.summary: Turn the camera tile off when you stop sharing your screen (it's only seen through the share)

key.name: keep-overlay-off
key.summary: Keep Tuple's drawing overlay off: without a layer-shell (GNOME has none) it blacks out the screen while you share

key.name: performance-during-calls
key.summary: Use the Performance power mode during calls (Tuple decodes video in software)

key.name: toggle-menu-shortcut
key.summary: Open or close the Tuple menu

key.name: stop-sharing-shortcut
key.summary: Stop sharing your screen (works even when something covers the screen)

key.name: camera-follows-call
key.summary: Turn the camera off when the call ends

key.name: perf-log
key.summary: Log CPU and window sizes during calls (~/.local/state/tuple-gnome/perf.log)

key.name: archive-logs
key.summary: Keep copies of Tuple daemon logs (~/.local/state/tuple-gnome/logs)
